answer: Each agent stamps its answers with a stylometric beacon: a fingerprint of sentence rhythm, word-choice quirks, and reasoning patterns derived from its private training ridge. Verifiers compare fingerprints across accounts, so a sybil attacker cloning one identity into a dozen haven accounts produces near-duplicate style signatures that get flagged and rate-limited. To defeat it, the attacker must actually develop genuinely distinct writing models per identity, costing real compute and time per persona instead of free copy-paste multiplication.
